pageTitle: About the Track a case service
heading: About the {{applicationName}} service
insetStrong: If you need help with your case
insetBody: Contact your police witness care officer if you have any questions about your case.
earlyVersion: You are seeing a very early version ('private beta') of the {{applicationName}} service.
designedFor: This service is designed for people who have experienced a crime that has gone to court. It aims to help you to:
aimsItems: find all the information you need to go through the justice process
know what you need to do
addingFeatures: We're still adding new features to the service, and you can help shape it.
helpShape: By completing our feedback form or joining our research panel, you can give us your opinions and help us understand how the service can better help you.
feedbackText: Tell us what you think about the service so far.
feedbackLinkText: Complete the {{applicationName}} feedback form (opens in new tab)
researchIntro: When you join our panel, you can be one of the first to try out our new features and help us shape the service.
researchInvited: You may also be invited by our researchers to take part in:
researchOpt: You can take part as you wish, and opt out any time. You do not need to be good with computers or the internet to take part.
researchLinkText: Join the {{applicationName}} research panel (opens in new tab)
